market.question: Will the highest temperature in Kuala Lumpur be 34°C on May 7?

assessment.reasoning: Kuala Lumpur typical May high is 32-33°C (89-91°F). Question requires high to be exactly 34°C bin on May 7, which is at upper end of typical range. Specific search showed forecast in 88-93°F range. Probability of landing in the 34°C bin is moderate-to-low.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Cloud cover and rainfall could keep temps below 34°C
